It computes per-sea-cell Hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from contiguous daily baseline data (C10:L16-L26), wrap-smooths them over 31 days, then selects only the smoothed rows for days of year 153-244 (Jun-Aug). Those rows depend on raw days 138-259, whose ±5-day pools span 12 May-20 Sep of each baseline year; the Dec/Jan padding days do not reach the mask. All 92 target days of every sea cell feed the hot-day comparison and the run/gap logic written to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
